title: Should phones be banned at school?

questions.context: A school proposes banning phones to reduce distractions; some pupils use them for accessibility support

options.text: Limit distracting use while making clear accessibility exceptions
Ban every use because all pupils have identical needs

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: A proportionate response can address distraction without ignoring access

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: A proportionate response can address distraction without ignoring access

questions.context: Theo says, “A ban might help, but it depends on how it’s enforced”
A survey reports that some pupils find phones distracting
questions.prompt: Which conclusion stays within that evidence?

options.text: Every pupil learns better under a total ban
Distraction is a concern worth addressing

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Some pupils’ reports do not establish a universal effect

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Some pupils’ reports do not establish a universal effect

questions.context: Kim says, “I take your point about emergencies, but…”

options.text: She acknowledges the concern before presenting a different consideration
She has fully accepted the other person’s entire proposal

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Acknowledging one point does not mean agreeing with every conclusion

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Acknowledging one point does not mean agreeing with every conclusion

questions.context: One person suggests a trial restriction with a review after six weeks
questions.prompt: What would make the trial more informative?

options.text: Deciding in advance that it must be called a success
Agreeing beforehand what changes they will measure

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: A trial needs criteria that can support or challenge the proposal

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: A trial needs criteria that can support or challenge the proposal

questions.context: You disagree with a blanket ban but accept that disruption needs action
questions.prompt: Which reply makes that position clear?

options.text: I agree we need limits; I’m not convinced a blanket ban is the best way
There’s no problem at all because I dislike the ban

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Separate agreement on the problem from disagreement on the solution

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Separate agreement on the problem from disagreement on the solution

phrases.displayText: Would you support a complete phone ban at school?
phrases.translation: Você apoiaria a proibição total de celulares na escola?

phrases.displayText: I’d support restrictions, although I’m not sure a total ban would be fair
phrases.translation: Eu apoiaria restrições, embora não tenha certeza se uma proibição total seria justa

phrases.displayText: What kind of exceptions would you make?
phrases.translation: Que tipo de exceções você faria?

phrases.displayText: Some students use their phones for accessibility or medical reasons
phrases.translation: Alguns alunos usam seus celulares por motivos de acessibilidade ou médicos

phrases.displayText: That makes sense. The main problem is distraction during lessons
phrases.translation: Faz sentido. O principal problema é a distração durante as aulas

phrases.displayText: Exactly. Whereas adults can choose when to check messages, younger students may need clearer boundaries
phrases.translation: Exatamente. Enquanto os adultos podem escolher quando verificar as mensagens, os alunos mais jovens podem precisar de limites mais claros

phrases.displayText: Even adults find that difficult sometimes
phrases.translation: Até mesmo os adultos acham isso difícil às vezes

phrases.displayText: True. That’s why responsibility shouldn’t fall entirely on the students
phrases.translation: Verdade. É por isso que a responsabilidade não deve recair inteiramente sobre os alunos

phrases.displayText: So schools and families would need to agree on the rules
phrases.translation: Assim, escolas e famílias precisariam concordar com as regras

phrases.displayText: Yes. Despite the practical challenges, a shared approach could work better
phrases.translation: Sim. Apesar dos desafios práticos, uma abordagem compartilhada poderia funcionar melhor

phrases.displayText: I’d be more comfortable with that than with a rule that ignores individual needs
phrases.translation: Eu me sentiria mais confortável com isso do que com uma regra que ignora as necessidades individuais

phrases.displayText: Me too. The aim should be better learning, not simply fewer devices
phrases.translation: Eu também. O objetivo deveria ser um aprendizado melhor, não simplesmente menos dispositivos
